newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Elec to sell part of LG Info stake.
newsitem.headline: LG Elec to sell part of LG Info stake.

text.p: LG Electronics Inc said on Thursday it plans to sell part of its stake in LG Information and Communication Ltd in the open market by September.
An LG Electronics statement said it plans to sell 100,000 of the 2.84 million shares in LG Information that it currently holds.
LG Electronics, one of South Korea's top three consumer electronics makers, said its current ownership stood at 18.33 percent of LG Information's outstanding shares issued.
Both companies are units of the LG Group.
LG Electronics said it had already sold another 163,520 shares in LG Information during the first quarter of the year.
The statement did not specify the purpose of the sale.
